title: plugin-auth: auth.handleRequest serves the plugin's whole /api/v1/auth surface (S1), so a multi-tenant host that forwards to it gains every objectstack-mount route with no route copy
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer ruled in session (2026-11-12), verbatim: 「同意 S1」, on the evaluation objectstack#32612 (comment 6818384543, the shape S1 in its section 3).

## 维护者速读

框架登录插件把现成「挂路由」的函数在一张私有路由表上再调用一次，`auth.handleRequest` 改为服务插件自己的全部登录接口。自托管不变（同一个函数、同一个调用点），接口契约形状不变。托管等宿主本来就调 `handleRequest`，升级后自动拿到全部 39 条框架登录接口，不用再手工照抄。

## Work (the shape from #32612 §3; verify every line number on current main)

1. `registerAuthRoutes(httpServer, ctx)` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` ~L3696 on `67c49d77`) takes the raw app. The kernel:ready caller (~L1548) keeps its `getRawApp` probe and passes the host app, so self-host's registrations, their order, the four `basePath/*` middlewares and the catch-all are unchanged.
2. AuthPlugin builds one private Hono app per kernel in `init`, after the manager exists (~L900), by calling the same function with root-path discovery off, and binds that app's `fetch` to the manager as its surface entry.
3. `AuthManager.handleRequest` (`auth-manager.ts` ~L4065) answers through the bound surface. The current vendor-only body moves to a vendor entry, and internal re-dispatch callers switch to it (#32612 §3 item 3 lists them). `ownsRoute` also answers true for the plugin's own table.
4. No `IAuthService` shape change; its `handleRequest` jsdoc gains one sentence (`packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts` ~L162-167). The change matches ADR-0090 D10.
5. Tests, in the existing plugin-auth suite (NO new `check:*` gate): (i) on a `registerRoutes: false` composition, every `source: 'objectstack'` ledger row answered through `auth.handleRequest` is not the vendor's disclaiming 404, derived from the ledger so a later route is covered with no edit; (ii) the private table's route set equals the raw-app set.
6. `hono` moves from devDependencies to dependencies in plugin-auth's `package.json`; a `minor` changeset (`handleRequest` answers more paths).

`check:auth-mount-ledger`'s census and the conformance pin must stay green unchanged. No route may become reachable through `handleRequest` that self-host does not serve: the same function is the source of both sets.

## Acceptance

Items 1–6 land; self-host suites unchanged; test (i) fails if any objectstack row 404s through `handleRequest` (ablation shown). Diff stays under 3000 lines.

Follow-up (not this card): the cloud PR that deletes its hand-mounts after the pin bump (filed with this one), and the optional removal of the hono embed adapter's own `/auth/config` copy.

Reader: `domain:server` lane (plugin-auth). Dispatched by `repo:cloud#5` on the maintainer's ruling.

Dedupe: the evaluation #32612 is the only card on this; #32401 (closed) was the per-route export this replaces.
